full_name_ar: مجاشع بن عبد الملك بن مجاشع
bio: Listed in Ibn Hibban's Kitab al-Thiqat (vol. 7, Atba' al-Tabi'in, Bab al-Mim), vol. 7 p. 513. Mujashi' b. 'Abd al-Malik b. Mujashi' b. Mas'ud al-Sulami al-Bahzi was from Basra; he narrates from Mujashi' b. Mas'ud (called his paternal uncle in the text), and Qurra b. Khalid narrates from him.
research_evidence: مجاشع بْن عبد الْملك بْن مجاشع بْن مَسْعُود السّلمِيّ الْبَهْزِي من أهل الْبَصْرَة يروي عَنْ عَمه مجاشع بْن مَسْعُود رَوَى عَنْهُ قُرَّة بْن خَالِد
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Listed in Ibn Hibban's Kitab al-Thiqat (vol. 7, Atba' al-Tabi'in, Bab al-Mim), vol. 7 p. 514. Mudarib al-'Ijli, of Bakr b. Wa'il, narrates mursal reports; Qatada narrates from him. Ibn Hibban adds that if he is not Mudarib b. Hazn, he does not know who he is.
research_evidence: مضَارب الْعجلِيّ من بكر بْن وَائِل يروي الْمَرَاسِيل روى عَنْهُ قَتَادَة إِن لم يكن مضَارب بْن حزن فَلَا أَدْرِي من هُوَ
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Listed in Ibn Hibban's Kitab al-Thiqat (vol. 7, Atba' al-Tabi'in) (Bab al-Nun), vol. 7 p. 537. Nasr b. Hassan al-'Anbari al-Tamimi, grandfather of Mu'adh b. Mu'adh al-'Anbari, narrates from Husayn b. Abi al-Hurr; Shu'ba b. al-Hajjaj narrates from him.

bio: Listed in Ibn Hibban's Kitab al-Thiqat (vol. 7, Atba' al-Tabi'in) (Bab al-Nun), vol. 7 p. 539. Nasr b. Aws Abu al-Minhal al-Ta'i was from Kufa; he narrates from 'Abd Allah b. Yazid from Abu Hurayra, and 'Abd Allah b. al-Mubarak and Waki' narrate from him.

full_name_ar: نفاعة بن مسلم أبو الخصيب الجعفي
bio: Listed in Ibn Hibban's Kitab al-Thiqat (vol. 7, Atba' al-Tabi'in, Bab al-Nun), vol. 7 p. 547. Nifa'a b. Muslim Abu al-Khasib al-Ju'fi was from Kufa; he narrates from Suwayd b. Ghafala that Suwayd prayed the noon prayer in the midday heat as soon as the sun passed its zenith, and when al-Hajjaj asked him about it he said he had prayed it so with 'Umar b. al-Khattab. Waki' and the people of his town narrate from him.
research_evidence: نفاعة بْن مُسلم أَبُو الخصيب الْجعْفِيّ من أهل الْكُوفَة يروي عَن سُوَيْد بْن غَفلَة
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 7, Atba' al-Tabi'in) (p. 548) gives his full lineage as Nufayl b. Hisham b. Sa'id b. Zayd b. 'Amr b. Nufayl. He narrated from the Medinans and was a transmitter for Hisham b. 'Urwa; al-Mubarak b. Fadala narrated from him.

full_name_ar: يزيد بن عبد الله بن موهب
bio: The page quotes Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat and al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-kabir: Yazid b. 'Abdullah b. Mawhab was the judge (qadi) of the people of Syria; he narrated from his father from Abu Hurayra, and Raja' b. Abi Salama and Abu Sinan 'Isa narrated from him.
